demo-thread-priya.subject: Holiday party for 60 in December
demo-thread-priya.summary: First inquiry: company holiday party for about 60 people, second week of December, asking about private space options and pricing.
demo-thread-priya.reply:
Hi Priya,

Thank you for thinking of The Harborview for your holiday party. For a group of 60 the Terrace Room is a wonderful fit: it seats up to 70 with room for a welcome cocktail moment by the windows.

December dates book quickly, and the second week still has good availability. Our seasonal group menus start at $85 per person, and I have linked them below so you can browse.

Would a Thursday or a Friday evening suit your team better?

Warmly,
Sage | Events Assistant | The Harborview

demo-thread-priya.subject: RE: Holiday party for 60 in December

demo-thread-priya.reply:

Great question. Pricing flexibility is something our events manager handles personally, so I have looped in Jordan, who will get back to you shortly with options for a Thursday evening.

Warmly,

demo-thread-dana.subject: Rehearsal dinner for 24

Warmly,
